articles.title: 5 world market themes for the week ahead
articles.desc: An important week is upcoming with central banks like the Federal Reserve and European Central Bank making policy decisions. Major companies, including Alphabet, Amazon, and Microsoft, are set to report their earnings. Political events are also significant, with elections in Israel and Brazil influencing markets. China's leadership will hold discussions focused on party governance amidst external pressures.

articles.title: US consumer sentiment near record low ahead of midterm elections
articles.desc: In October, consumer sentiment in the U.S. plummeted to a concerning 48.0, driven by rising prices and economic worries amid the ongoing Middle East conflict. Survey results suggest that independents show the steepest drop in confidence, approaching historical lows. Additionally, inflation expectations have risen, marking a continuation of trends from earlier this year. Federal Reserve officials are attentively observing these shifts as they plan future interest rate adjustments.

articles.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Earnings flood, Fed meeting will test rickety AI market rally
articles.desc: US stock investors are on the edge of their seats as they anticipate quarterly earnings from tech giants like Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon. This week is pivotal, with the Federal Reserve meeting also in sight, likely to shape how investors feel about the AI sector. After disappointing earnings from firms such as Meta and Lam Research, mixed sentiment looms over the market, especially with the midterm elections on the horizon.

articles.title: Indians remit $2.7 billion overseas in August, led by travel
articles.desc: Outward remittances under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) stood at $2.7 billion, with travel accounting for the largest chunk. Indians spent $1.6 billion on travel in August, from $1.7 billion in July, while $275 million were spent on maintenan-ce of relatives. Indian citizen spent $321 million on investments in equity and debt, while $191 million on studies abroad.

articles.title: Gross FDI inflows to India fall to $11 billion in August
articles.desc: Gross foreign direct investment (FDI) to India decreased to $11 billion in August, from $14 billion a month ago. Net FDI to India slows $3 billion in August, from $7 billion in July. Financial services, communication services, computer services and manufacturing accounted for around 73% of total FDI equity inflows during April-August 2026.

articles.title: Swiggy sinks 16% to record low as quick-commerce losses widen
articles.desc: Shares of Swiggy fell by 16.4% to ₹176.70, marking a record low for the company. This decline raises concerns over cash burn and achieving profitability in its quick-commerce business. Analysts are questioning Swiggy's strategic choices and execution following its market debut. The widening losses in the quick-commerce segment have drawn attention to the company's overall performance.

articles.title: BSE begins hunt for MD & CEO successor ahead of 2027 exit
articles.desc: BSE has initiated the search for its next managing director and chief executive officer. Sundararaman Ramamurthy is scheduled to retire in June 2027 after reaching the age limit. The exchange is looking for candidates with at least 20 years of experience, which includes senior leadership roles. Applicants need to be under 62 years old as of July 1, 2027.

articles.title: IndusInd Bank posts Rs 1,242 crore net profit on lower provisions
articles.desc: IndusInd Bank reported an impressive consolidated net profit of ₹1,242 crore for the September quarter, marking a robust recovery from the previous year's loss of ₹437 crore. This turnaround stems from decreased provisions and heightened fee income, alongside encouraging trends in asset quality, evidenced by reduced non-performing asset ratios. The bank's financial outlook showcases a significant improvement in both growth and profitability.

articles.title: India is not living in isolation, says Piyush Goyal, as India-EU FTA and several trade pacts pave the way for German R&D
articles.desc: Piyush Goyal emphasized the importance of collaboration between Indian and German research institutes during his visit. He highlighted the potential for co-development and co-innovation under the India-EU free trade agreement. Goyal encouraged the institutes to connect research with industry in order to support manufacturing in India. The minister also mentioned India's extensive trade agreements that will boost global market access.

articles.title: Infosys upbeat on deals, cautious on growth as competition intensifies
articles.desc: Infosys released its quarterly results, showing good revenue growth and stable operating margins. However, the management reduced the annual revenue guidance due to competitive pressures. The company secured a significant $2 billion deal, boosting its total contract value to $5.2 billion. Despite positive performance from some sectors, weaknesses in others contributed to the cautious outlook. The market response led to a rise in the stock price, affecting valuation metrics.

articles.title: Friday blockbuster for Jio IPO: Rs 7.4 lakh crore bids, 22x subscription
articles.desc: Jio Platforms has experienced a surge in demand for its initial public offering, garnering roughly ₹7.41 lakh crore in bids. The subscription soared to 22.19 times, mainly due to robust involvement from institutional investors, including domestic mutual funds and foreign entities. This enthusiasm contrasts with current trends in the secondary market, and shares are scheduled for listing on October 28, showcasing Jio's strides in the digital and telecommunications arenas.

articles.title: Small and midcap indices post worst weekly decline in two years
articles.desc: Mid-cap and small-cap stocks in India have faced major declines, indicating a shift in market sentiment. The Nifty MidCap 150 and Small-cap 250 indices reported their worst weekly falls in two years. Domestic retail investors initially supported these segments by increasing mutual fund contributions. However, concerns over rising oil prices and fiscal deficits are adding to market uncertainties.

articles.title: RBI’s forward dollar sales surge to record $200 billion in August
articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India recorded a net purchase of $43.26 billion in August's foreign exchange market. This was done to manage significant dollar inflows from the FCNR(B) scheme and overseas borrowings. Despite the net purchase, foreign exchange reserves did not increase due to large forex sell/buy swaps. By August 31, measures attracted over $127 billion, aiding the RBI's operations.

Employment increased slightly, although firms showed caution in hiring due to adequate staffing levels. Foreign Direct Investment remains robust, driven by significant inflows from major sources like the US and Singapore.

articles.title: India's exports to Germany could cross $50 billion by 2030: ASSOCHAM
articles.desc: ASSOCHAM said the potential for expanding market access, investment and business partnerships between India and Germany. It said the two countries could use their respective strengths in manufacturing, technology and innovation to deepen economic ties and create new growth opportunities.

articles.title: Shriram Finance Q2 profit jumps 59% YoY to Rs 3,677 crore on  strong interest income, lower funding costs
articles.desc: Shriram Finance reported a 59.4% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 standalone profit to Rs 3,677 crore, driven by higher net interest income and lower funding costs. Assets under management grew 17%, while the board declared an interim dividend of Rs 6.50 per share.

articles.title: Shree Cement profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 263 crore on higher fuel costs
articles.desc: Shree Cement’s September-quarter net profit fell over 15% year-on-year to Rs 263 crore for the third consecutive quarterly decline. Revenue rose 24% and sales volumes increased 14%, but soaring fuel costs pressured profitability despite stronger premium product sales.

articles.title: Jana Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 127%, raises FY27 growth outlook
articles.desc: Jana Small Finance Bank reported a 127% year-on-year rise in Q2 profit to Rs 170 crore, supported by business growth, higher margins and improved gross asset quality. The bank raised its annual profit growth guidance to 100%, while loans and deposits expanded.

articles.title: RBI flags rising inflation risks from West Asia conflict, El Nino despite resilient Indian economy
articles.desc: India's external sector shows resilience due to a narrowing trade gap and comfortable foreign exchange reserves. Inflationary pressures have intensified due to geopolitical tensions and supply-side bottlenecks. The RBI reported an increase in both industry and services indicators, showcasing economic strength. The IMF has revised India's growth projection for 2026-27 to 7% based on resilient domestic demand. Global financial volatility has increased amid global challenges and rising inflation risks.

articles.title: RBI governor reiterates listing requirement for top NBFCs as focus intensifies on Tata Sons

articles.title: Jio IPO breaks 12 records: Rs 4.5 lakh crore bids, highest applications and more
articles.desc: Mukesh Ambani’s Jio Platforms IPO attracted bids exceeding Rs 4.5 lakh crore, setting 12 records, including over 1.25 crore applications. articles.title: RBI's Rs 2.5 lakh crore liquidity infusion raises questions over tightening policy signal: SBI Report
articles.desc: In its report, SBI said the RBI had consistently signalled its commitment to monetary tightening through its policy resolution, the Governor’s statement and the minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC). The liquidity infusion through repo auctions, however, appeared difficult to reconcile with this approach.

articles.title: Aditya Birla Real Estate eyes Rs 1,650 cr revenue from new project in Pune
articles.desc: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd has announced plans to develop a housing project in Pune. This initiative will generate an estimated revenue of Rs 1,650 crore through a Joint Development Agreement. The project, located in Hinjewadi, spans 5.62 acres and features a total saleable area of approximately 1.25 million sq ft. Birla Estates, a subsidiary of Aditya Birla Real Estate, will oversee the project development.

articles.title: RBI does not target any specific Rupee level, focuses on curbing volatility, says Governor Sanjay Malhotra
articles.desc: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governor Sanjay Malhotra on Friday said the central bank does not target any specific exchange rate or level for the rupee against the US dollar, stressing that its primary objective is to ensure orderly conditions in the foreign exchange market and prevent excessive volatility.

articles.title: SBI Cards Q2 profit jumps 75% YoY to Rs 778 crore as bad loan costs fall sharply
articles.desc: SBI Cards reported a 75% year-on-year profit increase to Rs 778 crore in Q2 FY27, driven by lower credit costs and improved asset quality. However, corporate card spending declined, receivables contracted, and net interest margins narrowed.

articles.title: PLFS set for fresh overhaul, govt seeks public & expert opinion on upcoming new things
articles.desc: The National Statistics Office (NSO), which has conducted the PLFS since 2017, plans to introduce the modifications from January 2027, when fresh samples for the 2027-2028 two-year period, designated Panel 6, will be drawn using an updated sampling frame.

articles.title: Satellite lights, Google searches cut state growth estimation errors by up to 62%: RBI study
articles.desc: RBI study indicates that combining night-time light data with Google search trends can improve state economic growth estimates. Researchers tested their model in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Karnataka, showing significant reductions in forecasting errors. This framework could help provide timely economic insights, as state data is often delayed. Night-time illumination proved to be a strong predictor of Gross State Value Added growth.

articles.title: Why US stocks are falling: Dow Jones crashes over 700 points as AI selloff, SpaceX fears hit markets

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell markedly, affecting overall investor sentiment in the market. Concerns regarding competition from SpaceX led to drops in major telecom stocks such as AT&T and Verizon. Meanwhile, energy stocks achieved record highs as oil prices rose amid ongoing supply concerns.

articles.title: Bharat Electronics among 4 Sensex stocks to hit 52-week lows; shares fall up to 9% in a month

articles.title: Inflation stays high, growth slows, central bankers face a bigger challenge, says RBI Guv Malhotra
articles.desc: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra highlighted the challenges faced by central banks due to global uncertainties and supply chain issues. He noted the elevated global inflation and lower growth forecasts impacting monetary policy decisions worldwide. India entered this phase with strong macroeconomic fundamentals, maintaining growth at 7.8% despite rising inflation levels. The RBI's goal remains to achieve price stability while ensuring financial market order and health.

articles.title: SK Hynix drops US IPO plan for Solidigm: Report
articles.desc: The news comes weeks after SK Hynix said it was reviewing various options to strengthen Solidigm's competitiveness, but that no decisions had been made.

articles.title: India eyes 30 million tonnes fish output in 5 years, seafood exports of Rs 1.25 lakh crore
articles.desc: India has initiated a national action plan for inland small-scale fisheries to increase fish production. The plan aims to achieve a target of 30 million tonnes over the next five years. It will focus on improving livelihoods and sustainability amid climate change challenges. Stakeholder consultations will be conducted to finalise the plan, which covers diverse aquatic ecosystems.

articles.title: China's DeepSeek, MiniMax win approval for AI global use, state media-affiliated entity says
articles.desc: In a separate social media post on Friday, the social media account, Yuyuan Tantian, said overseas internet users had also urged other Chinese open-source large language models to follow suit.

articles.title: AI-discovered bugs may soon trigger fresh disruptions, cyber experts say
articles.desc: AI helped drive a doubling of the number of digital flaws discovered year-on-year, according to research due to be published in the coming days by VulnCheck, a Massachusetts-based threat intelligence firm.

articles.title: Apple bets iPhone Duo can remake foldable market as sales begin
articles.desc: Its reception could prove an early test for new Apple CEO John Ternus, the former hardware chief who unveiled iPhone Duo barely a week after taking charge in September.

articles.title: Pathos AI teams up with Bristol Myers and Tempus AI to advance drug development
articles.desc: Pathos AI said on Friday it had entered into a collaboration with Bristol Myers Squibb and Tempus AI to develop artificial intelligence tools for drug development in Alzheimer's

articles.title: Only 15% of midcap stocks above 50-DMA: Is buying the dip getting riskier? JM Financial spots signs of leadership shift
articles.desc: JM Financial warns midcap and smallcap leadership may weaken as market breadth deteriorates sharply. Largecaps show early recovery signals, but investors should remain cautious. Nifty holding 22,000 could trigger a rebound; breaking below risks a fall towards 20,500.

articles.title: What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble?
articles.desc: AI uncovered long-hidden programming flaws, triggering a rare global cyber-security response.

articles.title: US Stock Market Highlights: Dow Jones ends 600 pts lower as AI doubts persist ahead of Fed rate meet
India's 10-year bond falls for 10th week in record slump
articles.desc: Indian government bonds have experienced their worst decline in thirty years, falling consecutively for ten weeks. Rising crude oil prices and a hawkish central bank stance have impacted the market negatively. The benchmark repo rate was recently raised to 5.5%, with further increases expected. The 2036 bond yield rose to 7.4740%, indicating a broader trend of increasing yields. These developments may significantly affect India's import bill and inflation outlook.

articles.title: Despite global tensions, India’s business sentiment rebounds in Q2 FY27: NCAER
articles.desc: India's Business Confidence Index has risen to 107.8 in the second quarter of this fiscal year. The survey included 502 companies across six major cities, reflecting both large firms and MSMEs. All four key parameters evaluated by the index showed gains when compared to the previous quarter. NCAER indicated that confidence improved in expectations of economic conditions and financial health.

articles.title: Infosys ADRs crash 6% after Q2 results as revenue guidance cut spooks investors
articles.desc: Infosys ADRs fell 6.3% after the company lowered FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1-2%, despite September-quarter revenue beating estimates. Profit missed expectations, while large deal wins and AI revenue growth offered support amid cautious technology spending.

articles.title: Market wrap: Eternal, Apollo Hospital, Shriram Finance, Adani Enterprises among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
articles.desc: Indian equity markets fell for a fourth consecutive session, with the Nifty 50 closing at 22,600 and Sensex at 73,123.83. Small-cap, mid-cap and metal stocks slumped as bearish technical signals heightened concerns about further selling pressure.

articles.title: Island inflation rate rises to 3%, figures show
articles.desc: The rising cost of food and alcohol drives an increase in the inflation rate, figures show.

articles.title: Jio IPO becomes first public issue globally to cross 1 crore applications; record puts spotlight on depth of India’s retail investor base
articles.desc: Jio Platforms has achieved a remarkable milestone, garnering over one crore applications for its upcoming initial public offering. This surge signifies a burgeoning interest from India's retail investors in technology sectors. With the IPO set to debut on October 28, maintaining this enthusiasm is crucial. The communication strategies employed mirror those found in consumer marketing, urging potential investors to evaluate their financial objectives carefully before engaging with the IPO.

articles.title: Earnings limit of up to £140K for first-time buyers loan scheme
articles.desc: The Your First Home scheme will offer government-backed loans for those buying new-builds in England.

articles.title: India’s forex reserves fall $5 billion to $721.02 billion as of October 16
articles.desc: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by $5 billion to reach $721.02 billion for the week ending October 16. Previously, reserves declined by $8.578 billion to an amount of $726.027 billion. The decline in reserves reflects ongoing economic conditions impacting forex stability within the country. This trend indicates a continued volatility in India's foreign exchange market and its implications for the economy.

articles.title: AI stocks: Midterm elections could threaten AI trade as data center backlash grows
articles.desc: Public opposition to US data centers and the November midterm elections could reshape AI infrastructure investment. Increased regulatory scrutiny, rising electricity costs and construction delays may pressure technology stocks, utilities and power infrastructure companies, despite continued strong AI spending.

articles.title: European corporate earnings outlook improves as energy profits surge
articles.desc: European corporate earnings growth is forecast to reach 21.9% in the third quarter, driven by soaring energy profits amid US-Iran war volatility. However, inflation risks, elevated oil prices and rising borrowing costs threaten investor confidence and market stability.

articles.title: Infosys dividend alert! IT major announces Rs 26 per share dividend. Check record date
articles.desc: Infosys has declared an interim dividend of Rs 26 per equity share for its shareholders. The record date for this dividend is set for November 3, with payment scheduled for November 11. This announcement follows a final dividend of Rs 25 per share declared in June.

articles.title: Infosys Q2 Results: Profit rises 6% YoY to Rs 7,823 crore; co lowers revenue guidance
articles.desc: Infosys Q2 Results: IT services major Infosys Ltd on Friday reported 6% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 7,823 crore in the second quarter. The same stood at Rs 7,364 crore in the year-ago period. The company has trimmed its revenue growth guidance to 1-2% in constant currency for FY27 as against 1.5-3% given earlier.

articles.title: India’s labour survey to soon include platform workers and unpaid household work
articles.desc: India will update its Periodic Labour Force Survey starting January 2027 to enhance data collection. The modified sampling design aims to improve the identification of digital platform workers and unpaid household activities. Additionally, the updated sampling frame will reflect changes in urbanization and administrative boundaries. New questions will capture information on unpaid caregiving and volunteer work. Stakeholders are invited to provide feedback before the new sampling period begins.

articles.title: Mozambique eyes India partnership to boost agro-processing, expand rice trade across Southern Africa
articles.desc: Mozambique is set to elevate its agricultural collaboration with India, tapping into mutual strengths in agro-processing. Secretary Antonio Do Rosario Grispos emphasized that India's rice imports are crucial for ensuring food security in Mozambique. This partnership aims to enhance trade routes via Mozambique's ports, fostering regional commerce and agricultural growth while strengthening historical ties with India as a strategic ally.

articles.title: India must shift from rice volume to value, says Food Processing Minister Chirag Paswan
articles.desc: India has progressed in rice production and is now focusing on value addition and food processing. Food Processing Industries Minister Chirag Paswan outlined the need for improved quality and sustainability in the rice value chain. The government aims to enhance rice exports while promoting innovation in processing technologies. Strengthening agricultural links to industry is essential for achieving rural prosperity and increasing farmer incomes.

articles.title: Rubio turns to small Indian town as US faces high oil prices
articles.desc: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio pushed a business and energy agenda over diplomacy on his second trip to India this year.

articles.title: What is the Budget and what could be in it?
articles.desc: Chancellor John Healey will set out his plans for UK taxes on 28 October.

articles.title: The Indian workers filming their work to train AI
articles.desc: Indian workers are being paid to film themselves at work and the footage is used to train AI.

articles.title: Tech Mahindra, SpaceXSI partner to accelerate AI-powered software engineering
articles.desc: The company said it will combine its global engineering, enterprise transformation and AI consulting capabilities with SpaceXSI's AI-powered development platform to help enterprises expand application modernisation, streamline software development and improve code quality.

articles.title: Piyush Goyal discusses investment opportunities with Bayer, Fresenius
articles.desc: Piyush Goyal held meetings with Bayer and Fresenius executives to discuss investment opportunities in India's healthcare sector. During these discussions, Goyal explored Bayer's expansion plans and potential collaborations in healthcare. He also examined how Fresenius can leverage India's skilled workforce for the healthcare market. Additionally, Goyal engaged with Knauf Group regarding sustainable construction materials and manufacturing operations in India. These meetings highlight India's growing role in global healthcare and manufacturing.

articles.title: Zetwerk eyes manufacturing demand from AI, clean energy as shares debut
articles.desc: Shares of the business-to-business manufacturing platform opened at Rs 159 on the BSE, a 5.3% premium to the Rs 151 issue price, and at Rs 159.25 on the NSE. The stock subsequently gave up its gains to trade near the offer price amid weakness in broader markets.

articles.title: India October business growth hits 4-month high; hiring stalls, PMI shows
articles.desc: India's business activity expanded at its fastest pace in four months through a strong services-led pickup. The Composite Purchasing Managers' Index rose to 56.7 in October, exceeding forecasts due to increased orders. Despite this growth, hiring remained stagnant as companies managed workloads with current staff. Price pressures eased, resulting in lower input-cost inflation across both sectors. Overall, business confidence improved but remained below the average for the year.
